FR-019 (round-2 R05 clarification) is now fully in scope and consistent with FR-026. Quality checklist at checklists/requirements.md re-validated: all items pass, 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers, FR-001..FR-028 and SC-001..SC-010 verified present. HANDOFF.md updated with milestone 3 state. Conflicting old design note remains recorded as superseded (A9). Ready for $speckit-plan.
